demoBadge.label: Demo mode — mock data
demoBadge.tooltip: Requests are answered by an in-browser mock API. Uploads simulate a pipeline run.

configError.title: The console can’t start
configError.description: The runtime configuration in app-config.js is missing or invalid. Fix the values below and reload the page. In the container they come from the API_URL, DOCS_URL, CONTACT_URL and DEFAULT_DAG_ID environment variables.
configError.demoDescription: The demo answers API requests with a service worker, and this browser didn’t allow it to register. Open the page in a regular browser window; private windows and some embedded browsers block service workers.

errors.serviceUnavailable: The API is unavailable. Check that it is running and try again.

welcome.title: From raw retail data to a dashboard in one upload
welcome.description: Datashelf stores your transactions file, runs an Airflow ETL pipeline on it and turns the results into sales, customer and seasonal charts.

upload.title: Upload
upload.description: Drop a CSV or JSON export. The file lands in object storage and starts a pipeline run.

process.title: Process
process.description: Airflow cleans the data and computes metrics, distributions and seasonal top products.

follow.title: Follow the run
follow.description: Watch the run move from queued to finished without leaving the console.

explore.title: Explore
explore.description: Open the dashboard for any stored file and download each chart as an image.

notFound.title: This page doesn’t exist
notFound.description: The link may be outdated or mistyped. Go back to the start page or open the console.

consoleNotFound.title: This console page doesn’t exist
consoleNotFound.description: Check the address or pick a section from the navigation.

home.intro: Datashelf turns raw retail transactions into a dashboard: upload a file, let Airflow process it, then explore sales, customers and seasonal products.

upload.title: Upload a dataset
upload.description: Send a CSV or JSON file to storage and start the ETL pipeline on it.

storage.title: Browse storage
storage.description: Find an uploaded file and open the dashboard built from it.

pipelines.title: Check pipelines
pipelines.description: See which Airflow pipelines are active and follow your recent runs.

dashboard.emptyTitle: No charts for this file yet
dashboard.emptyDescription: The pipeline publishes charts as each analysis step finishes, usually within a minute of the upload. Refresh to check again, or upload the file again if the run failed.

sales.title: Sales
sales.description: Revenue over time, by city and by store type.

customers.title: Customers
customers.description: Who buys, where they buy and how they pay.

seasons.title: Seasonal products
seasons.description: The five most frequent products in each season.

other.title: Other charts
other.description: Charts produced by the pipeline that have no dedicated place on this dashboard yet.

storage.intro: Raw datasets in object storage. Open one to see its dashboard.
storage.emptyDescription: Upload a CSV or JSON file to store it and run the ETL pipeline on it.

pipelines.dagsDescription: DAGs registered in Airflow and whether they accept runs.
pipelines.emptyDescription: Check that the DAG files are mounted into Airflow and that the DAG processor has parsed them.
pipelines.runsDescription: Runs started from this browser. The console API doesn’t list run history, so runs started elsewhere aren’t shown.
pipelines.noRunsTitle: No runs started from this browser
pipelines.noRunsDescription: Upload a dataset to start a pipeline run. Its progress shows up here.

upload.intro: Upload a retail dataset to store it and start the {{dagId}} pipeline. When the run finishes, its charts appear on the file’s dashboard.
upload.dropTitle: Drop a file here or click to choose one
upload.dropHint: CSV or JSON, one file per run
